title: Complete the paginated VCF Operations alerts client
prompt: Implement the unfinished VCF Operations Go client in `client.go`. Before implementing, research `acquireToken` and `getAlerts` in `specifications/vcf-operations/vcf-operations-openapi.json` from VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository at tag `9.0.0.0`. Confirm their `/suite-api` base path, methods, paths, authentication, query serialization, pagination, request and response schemas, status codes, and optional fields. Cite the exact specification URLs you consulted in your final answer. Use only those two operations. `CollectAlerts` must acquire an access token and retrieve every page of matching alerts. When an alerts request returns HTTP 401 part way through collection, acquire a fresh token and retry that same page while preserving alerts from pages already completed. Send only the filters that the caller set; in particular, omit unset `authSource`, `id`, and `resourceId` fields instead of sending empty JSON members or query values. Keep the existing public API and change only `client.go`. Run `go test -race ./...`. Verification checks complete pagination, optional-field omission, 401 refresh and replay of only the interrupted page, preservation of completed pages, and exact request shapes.
